name: Infosys
h1: Two integrations, one AI agenda, one view of the work
lede: Infosys is integrating Stratus Global and Optimum Healthcare IT while scaling Topaz-led AI programmes with clients such as ABN AMRO. A connected layer keeps every workstream visible without another status deck.
why_h2: A year of integration and AI scale-up
why_p: Acquisitions, a client collaboration extended around AI and a planned leadership transition all land in the same twelve months. Each one adds trackers, owners and dependencies.

signals.title: ABN AMRO collaboration extended
signals.body: On 30 September 2026 Infosys and ABN AMRO extended their strategic collaboration to accelerate AI-driven transformation.
signals.angle: Large AI programmes need programme-level visibility across delivery teams, in one place rather than many spreadsheets.

signals.title: CEO Designate appointed
signals.body: Ashiss Kumar Dash was appointed CEO Designate effective 23 July 2026, to become CEO and MD on 1 April 2027.
signals.angle: Succession periods surface operating priorities; a connected layer shows progress without decks.

signals.title: Optimum Healthcare IT acquisition completed
signals.body: Infosys completed the acquisition of Optimum Healthcare IT in May 2026, first announced on 25 March 2026.
signals.angle: Integration workstreams are cross-functional programmes that Airtable consolidates into one shared plan.

signals.title: Stratus Global acquired
signals.body: Infosys acquired insurance technology partner Stratus Global LLC on 21 April 2026 for USD 74 million including earnouts.
signals.angle: Two integrations in two months multiply the trackers; Airtable unifies them.

final_h2: Twenty minutes on integration and AI programmes
